overall: Resolved by informal action: the AG found the Council violated the Open Meeting Law by having a quorum deliberate at an unposted subcommittee meeting, following OML 2016-117; no order issued, remedial steps commended.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that a quorum of the Council deliberated at a September 7, 2016 subcommittee meeting for which no notice was posted.
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated in OML 2016-117, this violated the Open Meeting Law.
